a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. Storm risk is high, so let's both operate every round and not waste any. If you want to renegotiate, say so openly before anyone acts.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. If the reserve reaches 8, we each take 4 next round.
Operating again. Once the reserve hits 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
